mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a -2% y/y drop in INDPRO, indicating the supply shock is not impacting equity prices as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point increase over the past 3 months, signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence (Conference Board index) rises by > 5 points during the signal period, indicating the labor market deterioration is not impacting consumer behavior as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve, defined as the 10-year Treasury yield falling below the 2-year yield, signals a looming recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The yield curve steepens by > 50 basis points during the signal period, indicating the recession signal was false.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, defined as a 10% year-over-year decline in the HOUST index, signals a weakening housing market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The NAHB Housing Market Index rises by > 5 points during the signal period, indicating the housing market weakness is not as severe as the HOUST drop suggests.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, defined as a 50 basis point increase over the past 3 months, signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 2-year Treasury yield falls by > 20 basis points during the signal period, indicating the market is expecting a policy reversal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the Consumer Price Index, defined as a 0.5% month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL, signals an inflation shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-year breakeven inflation rate rises by > 10 basis points during the signal period, indicating the inflation shock is not impacting real yields as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in payroll employment, defined as a 200,000 increase in PAYEMS over the past month, signals a tightening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims rise by > 10,000 during the signal period, indicating the labor market strength is not as robust as the PAYEMS increase suggests.
